subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The student council wanted more bike parking.”?
options: Every Wednesday morning, two students read school news on the radio.
Mr. Kuo said, "I do not run because every morning is comfortable.
Every morning, club members recorded the numbers and posted them near the office.
Instead of only asking, they counted bikes every morning for two months.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Every Wednesday morning, two students read school news on the radio.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Mr. Kuo said, 'I do not run because every morning is comfortable.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Every morning, club members recorded the numbers and posted them near the office.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Instead of only asking, they counted bikes every morning for two months.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Instead of only asking, they counted bikes every morning for two months.」，答案為「Instead of only asking, they counted bikes every morning for two months.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Instead of only asking, they counted bikes every morning for two months.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
